signin.title: Open your Drive
signin.lead: Your phone holds the key. Scan this code with the BIShare app and the key comes to this browser, sealed for it alone. No password, no email.
signin.step1Body: Go to Drive, then Drive account, then Open Drive on the web.
signin.step2Body: Point the phone at the code on the right, or type the letters under it.
signin.step3Body: The phone shows letters. If they match the ones here, tap Approve.
signin.stayBody: Stays open for 30 days of use. Leave it off on a computer you share: the Drive locks when you close the tab, and after 12 hours without use.
signin.qrLabel: Sign-in code for the BIShare app
signin.typeInstead: Or type these letters in the app
signin.waiting: Waiting for your phone · new code in {left}
signin.footer: Files are opened in this browser. BIShare's servers only ever see sealed bytes.

needs.title: Needs you
needs.clearBody: Storage, trash and browsers are all fine.

empty.filesBody: Files you add in the BIShare app show up here.
empty.folderBody: Add files to it from the BIShare app.
empty.searchBody: Search looks at file and folder names, here in this browser.
empty.photosBody: Turn on photo backup in the BIShare app and they show up here.
empty.trashBody: Deleted files stay here for 30 days.

devices.sub: Every app and browser that holds your Drive's key
devices.browsersSub: {n, plural, =0 {None stays signed in} one {# stays signed in} other {# stay signed in}}
devices.note: To remove another device, use Devices in the BIShare app. Removing one takes the key away from it.

files.title: All files
files.privacy: Names, folders and types are decrypted here, in this browser. BIShare's servers only see sizes and times.

recent.sub: Files added or changed on any device, newest first

trash.sub: {n, plural, =0 {Empty} one {# item} other {# items}} · {size}. Each is deleted for good 30 days after it was moved here.
trash.note: To put something back, or delete it now, use the trash in the BIShare app.

storage.note: Files in the trash count until they are deleted for good.
storage.plansSub: US prices; your app store shows yours
storage.buyInApp: Plans are bought in the BIShare app, through the App Store or Google Play.

security.sub: What BIShare can and can't see, and how this browser holds the key
security.encryptionSub: The same for the app and the web
security.e2eBody: Files are encrypted on your device before they leave it. The key is never sent to BIShare.
security.hiddenBody: BIShare's servers can't read any of them.
security.visibleBody: The servers see how big each file is, when it was uploaded, and what is in the trash.
security.stayOn: Stays open for 30 days of use.
security.stayOff: Locks when you close the tab, or after 12 hours without use.
security.lockBody: Removes this browser from your Drive and deletes the key here. Scan a new code to open it again.
security.phraseBody: Shown and checked only in the BIShare app, never on the web.
security.deleteBody: Done in the BIShare app, under Drive account.
